title: Final Energy Change
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the change in electrostatic energy.

title: Charge Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly calculate the charge Q using the given potential and radius of the bubble.

title: Energy Formula Application
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the formula for electrostatic energy change between the two radii.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the energy change calculation.

title: Substitution Accuracy
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately substitute values into the equations without errors.

title: Limiting Cases Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or implications of the radius change on energy.
